describe.description: Print this UCII manifest: the operations, parameters and effects of the project.

test.description: Run the offline test suite against a fake provider. Needs no API key and no network.

verify.description: Run clj-kondo, the cljfmt check, splint and carve over src, test, extensions, ci, examples and bin, then check that this manifest matches the Makefile. Changes no project files.

fmt.description: Rewrite src, test, extensions, ci, examples and bin with cljfmt. Changes files in the working tree.

agent.description: Run bba from source in the current folder. With a prompt it answers once and exits; without one it opens the interactive session. Calls the configured model provider.
